what: The mean of each named feature over each stand polygon of sanjay_van_alphaearth_keptland (docs/reproducibility/keptland_runs/sanjay_van_alphaearth_keptland_stands_merged.geojson), by one read-only reduceRegions (mean, 10 m) over cached feature images; spec-ui-alphaearth-stands-named-means-by-reduction.
note: The radar and static means are the baseline kept-land run's (sanjay_van_baseline_keptland): the AlphaEarth arm computes no radar or static features. The optical and structure means are the AlphaEarth run's own (sanjay_van_alphaearth_keptland). All are means over the AlphaEarth run's stand polygons.
